newsitem.title: USA: Stratosphere reports cash flow for Jan..
newsitem.headline: Stratosphere reports cash flow for Jan..

text.p: Stratosphere Corp on Wednesday said its consolidated cash flow for the four weeks ended January 26 was $553,622, and the average consolidated cash flow for the four months ended January 26 was $1.77 million.
The news sent the price on Stratosphere's 14-1/4 percent First Mortgage Notes tumbling to a bid of 83 and offer of 84 from Tuesday's closing price of 88-1/2, traders said.
Under a current debt restructuring plan, Stratosphere must maintain an average monthly operating cash flow of $2.267 million between October 1996 and June 1997.
Stratosphere is currently in a pre-packaged Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceeding and is required to make the cash flow statements as part of its agreement with holders of its notes.
